items.title: SIH internal hackathon
items.plain: College shortlisting round on 22 September. The venue changed this morning.
items.action: Form a team of 6 with at least one female member and shortlist problem statements
items.deadline_text: internal hackathon date is 22nd, as announced in class
items.uncertainty: No start time has ever been given, only the date.
items.issue: The SIH portal still shows old problem statements and a different team size. The faculty coordinator says to proceed on verbal information and that the website will catch up.
items.clash_note: Three things land on 22 September: this, the Neutron orientation (12-3 PM) and the University-Wide Hackathon registration deadline. No start time is given for this one, so an overlap with Neutron cannot be ruled out.

history.what: Team size confirmed as 6, minimum 1 female. Internal hackathon date announced as the 22nd - 'this is final'.
Venue shifted from IT 209 to Anveshan Foundation. Schedule is 2 days.

sources.excerpt: internal hackathon date is 22nd, as announced in class. Kindly stop circulating unconfirmed dates.

items.title: Semester registration
items.plain: Two different closing dates were circulated and neither came from an official source. Worth checking.
items.action: Verify your registration status with the department
items.deadline_text: tomorrow is the last date for sem registration / I know the site says 30 Sept
items.uncertainty: Neither date is from an official source - both are students in a group chat.
items.issue: Two conflicting dates in one thread. One student says the portal says 30 September; another says the deadline was 'tomorrow', which would have been 4 September. Both cannot be right.

sources.excerpt: tomorrow is the last date for sem registration ... I know the site says 30 Sept

items.title: Merit-cum-Means Scholarship
items.plain: Applications open for first-years. Documents go to the Scholarship Office by 25 September.
items.action: Submit income certificate, academic records and Aadhar to Room 104, Admin Block
items.consequence: Incomplete applications will not be entertained
items.why_here: Posted 28 days ago in Official Notices Group - a channel nobody scrolls back through.

sources.excerpt: applications for the Merit-cum-Means Scholarship are now open ... by 25th September 2026

items.title: Tarang fest auditions
items.plain: Auditions for Dance, Music, Drama, Fine Arts and Literary, 20-23 September in the Main Auditorium.
items.action: Register on the society Instagram pages, or report to the venue with your college ID
items.uncertainty: Category-wise timings are only on the Auditorium notice board, not in the message.
items.issue: This notice was posted on 25 August. Two days later, freshers in another group were still asking when the auditions were, whether there was a form, and which categories existed - none of them had seen it.
items.why_here: The answer existed two days before anyone started looking for it - in a channel they were not reading.

sources.excerpt: Auditions for various societies ... 20th-23rd September 2026 in the Main Auditorium

sources.excerpt: University-Wide Hackathon ... 28th-29th September 2026. Team registration ... by 22nd September 2026
